main_text.p: Arteriæ adfectus uno tempore, simulatq; illa attollitur, plurimi attendendi:

Distensionis quantitas.
Mouentis eam facultatis, robur.
Tunicæ status.
Capedo interna.
Qualitas & tempus motus.
main_text.head: DE PVLSVVM DIFFERENTIIS.
main_text.p: Arteria tres habente dimensiones, in singulis est distensionis quantitas. Hinc pulsuum differentiæ nouem.

page.notes: The running head is the printed word "PVLSVVM" on the verso page; the faint text at the top right is show-through and was left out. The heading "DE PVLSVVM DIFFERENTIÆ" is split over two lines; the printed word reads "Differentiis" with long-s style "differentiis" as shown. The spelling "differentiæ" in the paragraph is as printed. The catchword "In" is printed at the lower right.
